criteria.evidence: All four detailed-stage sections plus Agent intent (ICE) are present and substantive: e.g. Boundary 'Out: laying Phoenix memory on the machine and bringing it up to date. The Phoenix install owns it'; Guiding rules 'When the memory tool cannot reach Phoenix memory, initialize stops and builds nothing'; Features lists six features each with an explained line.

Each edge and rule carries its reason: 'Never: make a work-item type in the tracker before the product owner's typed yes. A tracker is an outside system, and a write there is visible to the whole team.'; 'Never: propose an answer without naming its source. A proposal with no source hides a guess, and the person cannot judge it.'; 'These six jobs share one moment (the project is being set up) and one input (the product owner's answers), so they live in one capability.'

'We will know it is true when: one play (`initialize`) asks the questions, each with choices and a proposed answer that names its source; the answers set up the project's Garura memory ...; two projects on one machine with different answers hold different blocks; a review in the project runs only the rule groups that fit and its record names the groups it skipped; the tracker has each needed type or a named stand-in; and the product owner can run `initialize` again when the project or Phoenix memory changes.'
criteria.fix: Split the proof bullet in Benefit hypothesis into one sub-bullet per check under 'We will know it is true when:' (questions carry choices and a sourced proposal; project memory holds only the selected blocks and the profile records the answers; two projects with different answers hold different blocks; a review runs only fitting rule groups and names the skipped ones; the tracker has each type or a named stand-in; initialize can run again). Six checks packed into one semicolon run-on reads as a paragraph, not discrete points.

criteria.evidence: Parent domain gives one directional Intent paragraph ('it shapes one slice ... plans that slice as work items in the tracker, and it writes the eval') and is marked 'To be deepened later'; the capability adds defined terms ('A memory block is the set of Phoenix memory files that one setup answer selects'), named neighbouring owners, six reasoned guiding rules, six features and a full ICE.

What: 'one run of `initialize` sets the project up from the product owner's answers: its memory, its review rule groups and its tracker's work-item types.' Why: 'The value is fewer wrong findings, a smaller memory that fits the project, and no play that stops on a missing type.' Edges: Out lines name the Phoenix install, the Garura install, /check-change and /shape-slice + /shape-plan; terms Phoenix memory, memory block and rule group are defined in Boundary. Minor gaps a cold reader would notice but that do not block understanding: 'the profile' is never said to be the product profile, and two feature ids ('fn-881', 'fn-883') are bare numbers unlike the named ids of the other four.
